competences.description: Inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns if you land a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Channels burning rage to inflict damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken. The damage increases according to the number of dead allies.

Gains immunity against inability effects and increases your Attack Power by 50% whenever other allies are attacked or granted with harmful effects, up to 5 times. In addition, counterattacks with a 50% chance when you are attacked, and increases the enemy's chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 1 turn when counterattacking with [King's Rage]. Afterwards, goes under the Threat state while the enemy attacks with a single-target skill 1 time. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: ATK increases by given amount under certain conditions
effets.note: Each time your allies are attacked or granted with harmful effects, up to 5 times

effets.description: When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
